strategies.label: Governed batch convergence
steps: Resolve current production/design authority before applying older research.

strategies.label: Governed product workflow design
steps: Start from a real user goal and name the responsible SONARA product and tenant boundary.
Map each visible action to an existing route, authenticated service, data owner, durable state transition and observable result.
Define loading, empty, error, retry, success, permission-denied, approval-pending and recovery states before polishing the happy path.
Prefer deterministic calculations and validations for known rules; label estimates, external-model results and unavailable inputs honestly.
Give each external side effect an idempotency key, bounded retry, audit event and required approval before execution.
Specify source provenance, retention, accessibility, device behavior and acceptance tests for the complete user journey.
Keep formula execution paused until the owner explicitly authorizes it; record the instruction and test scope before processing.
boundaries: A diagram or screenshot is not product truth, a database schema, a license, or execution authorization.
No fake reviews, sales, savings, performance, shipping, availability or customer metrics.
No external communication, publishing, payments, destructive changes or production deployment without the applicable owner approval.

strategies.label: Commercial open-source adoption
steps: Verify the actual repository license and distinguish source license from model/data/content licenses.
Use the formal open-source registry decision when it is stricter than an older screenshot/intake claim.
Prefer permissive MIT/Apache/BSD/PostgreSQL/CC0 projects when they solve a measured gap and commercial-use status allows adoption.
Keep GPL/AGPL/MPL/custom/source-available projects behind an explicit isolation/license decision.
Keep unlicensed or unresolved source out of product code and record provenance, version, configuration state, runtime boundary, and rollback path.
boundaries: Open source does not automatically mean unrestricted commercial use
No remote install scripts or secrets in prompts

strategies.label: Provider and model selection
steps: Use deterministic SONARA rules when a model is unnecessary.
Use Provider Gateway or an approved server-side adapter for hosted models.
Use isolated workers for GPU/media/local-model workloads.
Evaluate quality, rights, privacy, retention, latency, cost, availability, model-weight/data terms, and fallback behavior.
Persist provider/model/version/provenance metadata without logging secrets or unnecessary payload content.
boundaries: A registry record cannot execute a provider
Model weights and datasets remain separately licensed

strategies.label: Governed learning and memory
steps: Use authoritative organization records and deterministic checks before creating remembered context.
Classify the candidate as operational fact, owner preference, approved pattern, product feedback, research evidence, or ephemeral context.
Require organization scope, source provenance, purpose, retention policy, and explicit approval for preferences/patterns or sensitive memory.
Never retain credentials, raw card/CVV data, access tokens, private keys, passwords, or service-role secrets.
Enable semantic retrieval only after an embedding provider/model/dimension is explicitly reviewed and verified; otherwise keep text/metadata behavior deterministic.
Keep memory editable/removable and never treat remembered context as authority for consequential actions.
boundaries: No cross-tenant memory
No covert sensitive-trait inference
Memory cannot bypass owner, provider, campaign, payment, security, or release gates

strategies.label: Creator research-to-publish pipeline
steps: Research and define source/rights constraints.
Create through an approved provider or isolated worker.
Run quality, consent, copyright, privacy, and cost checks.

Publishing remains approval-gated

strategies.label: Growth campaign execution
steps: Build audience from authorized first-party records.
Check consent, suppression, eligibility, frequency, and owner approval.
Freeze the approved recipient snapshot before dispatch.
Send through configured providers with bounded retries and idempotency.
Record outcomes without silently expanding the audience on retry/resume.
boundaries: No unsolicited scraping-to-outreach pipeline
No guaranteed growth/conversion claims
Recipient approval is immutable for a dispatch

strategies.label: Business Builder operations delivery
steps: Use organization-scoped records and deterministic checks first.
Keep booking, staff, inventory, customer, invoice, and payment operations independently auditable.

Require approval for financial, destructive, or externally visible changes.
Expose setup-required and review-required states rather than fake success.
boundaries: No raw card/CVV storage

strategies.label: Authorized security review
steps: Confirm owned or explicitly authorized target scope before active testing.
Prefer passive/source-grounded review before active probes.
Run active tools only in isolated environments with bounded scope and audit logs.
Record findings without collecting unrelated credentials or personal data.
Keep fixes separate from exploit research and prove them with regression tests.
boundaries: No credential capture, lock bypass, covert tracking, unauthorized crawling, or destructive testing

strategies.label: Release evidence delivery
steps: Translate requirements into explicit acceptance criteria.
Implement in a branch with the smallest reviewable diff.
Run dependency, security, tenant-isolation, route, build, and release-evidence gates.
Fix the underlying source/contract instead of bypassing tests.
Merge only when required checks are green and production blockers are accurately named.
boundaries: Never force-push main
Never merge red required checks
Never weaken a release gate to manufacture green

strategies.label: Agent execution pattern routing
steps: Use single-shot for simple no-side-effect work.
Use bounded iterative ReAct only when tool feedback is necessary.
Use planner-executor for decomposable or long-running workflows while keeping executor permissions narrow.
Use reflexive loops for quality improvement, never as a substitute for independent validation.
Add verifier-gated review before high-impact, financial, security-sensitive, compliance, deployment, or data-mutation outcomes.
boundaries: Agent patterns are composable control-plane choices, not autonomous authority
Every loop has bounded iterations, cost/latency budgets, observability, and an explicit failure path

strategies.label: Business AI capability delivery
steps: Map the business problem and workflow before selecting an agent or model.
Build the context contract from instructions, goals, authoritative data, constraints, tools, and output requirements.
Ground answers in trusted organization sources where retrieval is enabled and keep unsupported assumptions visible.
Evaluate accuracy, relevance, tool success, latency, cost, privacy, and safety before promotion.
Deploy only through owned SONARA workflows with monitoring, human approval where required, and rollback paths.
boundaries: Do not add agents where deterministic workflow automation is sufficient
Public product copy must reflect measured runtime readiness rather than control-plane plans

strategies.label: Reusable agent skill contracts and assurance
steps: Define the skill purpose, typed inputs/outputs, allowed effects, tenant scope, data class and stop conditions before writing host instructions.
Keep deterministic work in tested code and use instructions to explain when and how an agent may call the capability.
Record exact source/version and inspect each code, dependency, prompt, hook, nested license, filesystem path, network call and secret requirement.
Test valid, invalid, unauthorized, resource-exhaustion and failure cases offline with synthetic data before registration.
Pin reviewed provenance, keep the capability disabled until owner approval, and document update, rollback and removal behavior.
boundaries: A skill, tool schema, manifest or registry entry never grants permission or widens SONARA agent authority.
Third-party skills are reviewed per artifact; a repository root license does not automatically cover bundled skills or their data/assets.
No third-party skill executes in production from research metadata.

strategies.label: Typed business decision design
steps: Define the finite outcome set and the authoritative fields before selecting an LLM or classifier.
Use deterministic code for thresholds, arithmetic, schema checks, tie handling and authorization wherever those rules are known.
If a model is useful for classification, measure calibration, false-positive/negative cost, drift and abstention on representative, permitted data.
Return reason codes and evidence with each decision; distinguish unknown, insufficient evidence and negative outcomes.
Keep customer, employment, financial, legal, security and production actions behind domain policy and required human approval.
boundaries: A score or confidence label is not proof, consent, eligibility or authorization.
Do not repeat infographic latency, cost or accuracy claims without current first-party sources and SONARA workload measurements.
Do not use automated scoring as the sole basis for high-impact business or employment decisions.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Android native client
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Install SONARA from Android as a first-class app while preserving the web product as the shared surface.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Adds an app-store distribution channel without forking the product into a separate Android codebase.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Ship the existing SONARA PWA through a verified Trusted Web Activity first. Introduce Capacitor only after SONARA has a local web asset bundle or a concrete native-plugin requirement; Capacitor server.url is not a production remote-host strategy.
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: SONARA OS remains a business/application operating system. This track does not claim a hardware kernel, device drivers, or Android replacement.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Integration gateway
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Connect customer tools through one governed connection layer instead of requiring one-off OAuth code for every provider.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Closes part of the ecosystem gap with larger automation platforms while keeping SONARA's tenant, audit, and approval model authoritative.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Build a provider-neutral connector contract for OAuth/API-key auth, token refresh, webhooks, sync jobs, rate limits, retries, and MCP/tool calls. Evaluate Nango-style infrastructure rather than claiming its catalog as SONARA-native coverage.
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: External gateway catalog size is not SONARA's native integration count. A connector becomes supported only after SONARA-specific auth, data, security, and canary evidence passes.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Autonomous event consumers
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Run reliable background workflows without making customers wait for synchronous requests.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Creates the execution backbone for notifications, campaigns, media work, integrations, and agent workflows.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Activate one low-risk tenant-scoped consumer canary over the existing durable outbox before any unrestricted worker network.
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: The event foundation exists, but unrestricted autonomous production consumers remain disabled until canary and release evidence pass.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Agent authority and approvals
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Let automation handle low-risk work while requiring human approval for destructive, financial, security, legal, or bulk-customer actions.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Allows SONARA to expand automation without turning broad agent access into unrestricted administrator authority.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Keep a single fail-closed authority classifier, signed approval evidence, policy checks, and audit records across every agent/event execution path.
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: SONARA will not promise fully unrestricted autonomous agents for sensitive actions; owner or delegated approval remains a product control.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Exact-head production proof
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Customers receive releases that passed the same code, migration, security, tenant, and provider checks that are actually deployed.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Prevents feature velocity from outrunning release confidence.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Require an exact-commit green matrix, controlled deployment dry-run, provider verification, migration evidence, and post-deploy health before production promotion.
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: No branch is production-ready merely because most tests pass. The complete required matrix is the release gate.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Provider resilience
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: See when an optional provider is configured, degraded, unavailable, or replaced instead of receiving unexplained failures.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Reduces support load and prevents optional vendors from becoming hidden single points of failure.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Standardize provider health probes, timeout budgets, circuit breakers, retry classes, setup-required states, and explicit fallback/provider-switch contracts.
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: SONARA can govern optional providers but cannot guarantee availability or account authorization controlled by third parties.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Specialist software bridges
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Move SONARA projects and business data into specialist CAD, ERP, DAW, accounting, video, and industry tools instead of forcing customers to abandon expert software.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Expands addressable industries without attempting to rebuild decades of specialist functionality inside one product.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Prefer adapters, open formats, APIs, MCP/tool contracts, import/export pipelines, and deep links before considering native replacements.
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: A bridge is not a claim that SONARA replaces AutoCAD, enterprise ERP, professional DAWs, regulated medical systems, industrial controls, or telecom infrastructure.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Opt-in social federation
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Publish or exchange approved creator/community content with decentralized social networks without making every SONARA workspace public.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Adds distribution and community reach while preserving SONARA's private-workspace default.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Implement an isolated ActivityPub boundary with explicit public actors, signed server-to-server delivery, moderation, rate limits, and tenant opt-in.
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: SONARA is not currently an open public social network; federation remains disabled until privacy, moderation, and abuse controls pass.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Passkeys and device security
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Use fingerprint, face, PIN, pattern, or security keys through the device credential system without SONARA storing raw biometric templates.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Improves sign-in conversion and phishing resistance while avoiding a biometric-database liability.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Add WebAuthn/passkey registration and authentication, with Android Credential Manager support and step-up reauthentication for sensitive operations.
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: SONARA stores public-key credential material and metadata, not fingerprints, face templates, or other raw biometric identity data.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Realtime media plane
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Support live audio/video rooms, calls, screen sharing, recording, streaming, and agent participation when a dedicated media plane is configured.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Adds communications and production workflows without forcing realtime media through general Vercel JSON routes.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Use a dedicated WebRTC SFU transport such as LiveKit, with TURN, ingress/egress, recording, E2EE options, telemetry, and later multi-region routing.
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: SONARA does not yet operate a global custom media relay/CDN network. Realtime media is a separately deployed capability.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Offline and local-first work
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Keep core customer work usable during weak or absent connectivity and synchronize safely when the network returns.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Improves mobile/field reliability and reduces dependence on a perfect connection.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Add a versioned offline shell, local data cache, encrypted mutation queue, conflict policy, resumable uploads, and explicit online-only boundaries.
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: Large collaborative media processing, live calls, payment authorization, and server-dependent workflows remain online services even when local drafts are available.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Governed repository activation
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Gain new capabilities from reviewed open-source work without silently executing every repository discovered during research.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Turns research breadth into a controlled technology pipeline rather than dependency sprawl.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Keep research records separate from install candidates; require immutable versions, licence review, SBOM/dependency evidence, a real call site, security tests, and canary activation.
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: Research or installation candidacy does not mean runtime activation or customer availability.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Unified commerce and store operations
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Sell the same canonical products through owned storefronts, POS, kiosks, pickup, delivery, and physical stores while keeping inventory, customers, orders, returns, and payment references synchronized.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Turns Business Builder into an owned-commerce operating layer for online sellers and brick-and-mortar operators without creating separate databases for each sales channel.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Build one tenant-scoped commerce contract over existing customer, catalog, inventory, vendor, location, order, invoice, payment, workflow, audit, and analytics primitives. Prove product/variant/SKU/GTIN identity, stock reservations, purchase/receiving, storefront checkout, POS/kiosk order capture, provider-confirmed payments, returns/refunds, register reconciliation, BOPIS, ship-from-store, and own-brand product lifecycle before expanding channels.
proofGates: one product/variant identity across storefront and POS
idempotent order payment and inventory mutations
provider-confirmed in-person and online payment states
BOPIS happy cancellation and expiry paths
barcode and GTIN validation without fabricated identifiers
accessible storefront POS and kiosk paths
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: Research, UI, formulas, provider documentation, and open-source catalogs do not prove unified commerce. SONARA may claim only the channels, hardware, payment paths, inventory synchronization, and omnichannel workflows that have passed tenant, concurrency, provider, accessibility, reconciliation, canary, and production evidence.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Hyperscale and disaster-recovery evidence
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Receive measurable reliability, performance, recovery, and regional-latency evidence instead of vague scale promises.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Creates the proof required before SONARA markets enterprise-grade or hyperscale reliability.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Instrument traces/metrics/logs, define SLOs/error budgets, add k6 smoke/load/soak/breakpoint tests, exercise backups/restores, add read replicas where justified, and run provider/region failure drills.
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: Architecture for scale is not evidence of hyperscale. SONARA must accumulate measured production history before using scale claims.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: AI decision assurance
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Use AI for drafting, analysis, retrieval, and bounded automation while deterministic checks and human authority protect consequential actions.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Makes AI a governed subsystem rather than a source of unverified business state.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Require structured outputs, evidence/provenance, deterministic validation, evaluation suites, approval thresholds, tool scopes, audit logs, and rollback for consequential AI-assisted actions.
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: SONARA will not promise that AI is always correct; deterministic controls and human accountability remain part of the product.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Developer and partner ecosystem
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Connect specialist tools through discoverable, versioned and supportable integrations instead of one-off custom wiring.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Turns SONARA from a closed product suite into an extensible platform while preserving one tenant, policy, billing and audit authority.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Create a governed developer platform with connector manifests, OAuth/API-key/MCP capability declarations, webhook and sync contracts, version compatibility, install/uninstall lifecycle, partner sandbox, documentation, security review metadata, receipts and usage metering. Start with a small verified catalog; catalog research does not count as a supported integration.
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: Marketplace listings, researched repositories and third-party gateway catalogs are not SONARA-native integrations. Count only connectors that pass SONARA auth, tenant, data, security, support and production-canary evidence.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Customer adoption and value proof
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Make onboarding, first value and recurring work measurably easier instead of assuming a large feature catalog creates adoption.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Creates the evidence needed to improve activation, retention, monetization, support and product-market fit without inventing traction.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Define one event taxonomy and tenant-safe product analytics model for qualified signup, workspace activation, time-to-first-value, first successful workflow, weekly active organizations, retained organizations, workflow success/failure, connector activation, trial-to-paid conversion, expansion, churn, support resolution and cost-to-serve. Cohorts must be date-scoped and denominator-defined.
proofGates: claim-review rule requiring measured denominators and dates
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: Do not publish customer count, retention, conversion, productivity, revenue-lift or ROI claims until they are measured from production data with a defined population, time window and denominator.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Vertical operating packs
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Give operators workflows, records, dashboards and terminology that match how their industry actually works while retaining one SONARA platform.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Builds defensible specialization without creating separate codebases and separate sources of truth for every industry.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Productize lighthouse packs over the shared work graph and commerce/communications/analytics primitives. Initial proof packs: restaurant/retail operations; trades and field service; fleet/trucking/delivery; construction/project operations. Each pack needs canonical records, state machines, role templates, dashboards, formulas, connector set, offline/device policy, industry vocabulary and measurable outcomes before expanding to additional packs.
proofGates: no duplicate source-of-truth tables for equivalent primitives
vertical sample dataset and deterministic fixtures
lighthouse-customer outcome measurement before broad expansion
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: A vertical pack is specialized workflow composition, not a claim that SONARA replaces specialist CAD, industrial control, regulated clinical, banking-core, telecom-core or other expert systems without validated adapters and domain-specific controls.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Enterprise-scale validation
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Provide evidence that larger organizations can operate reliably, isolate tenants, audit changes, recover failures and understand service limits.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Converts architecture claims into procurement-grade operational proof and identifies scaling limits before enterprise sales depend on them.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Build a repeatable enterprise validation program covering adversarial tenant isolation, per-tenant quotas and noisy-neighbor controls, workload/soak/spike tests, SLOs and error budgets, queue/backpressure limits, disaster recovery and restore drills, backup evidence, audit export, SSO/SCIM readiness, data export/deletion, regional/data-residency decisions, provider failure exercises, incident response, rollback and capacity-cost curves.
proofGates: published internal SLO and error-budget history
backup restore drill with measured RPO/RTO
capacity and cost model tied to measured workloads
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: Enterprise-ready is an evidence state, not a UI label. Do not claim enterprise scale, availability, recovery objectives, compliance certification or customer volume beyond completed and dated measurements.

capabilityExpansionTracks.label: Market and ecosystem scale evidence
capabilityExpansionTracks.customerValue: Customers can distinguish shipped capability and measured reliability from roadmap ambition.
capabilityExpansionTracks.businessValue: Builds credible competitive positioning without pretending current adoption or ecosystem size matches mature incumbents.
capabilityExpansionTracks.target: Publish internally measured connector counts, active organizations, successful workflow volume, uptime/SLO history, support resolution, retention, and production incident evidence before making scale claims.
capabilityExpansionTracks.claimBoundary: SONARA does not claim Salesforce-, Shopify-, Canva-, HubSpot-, Wix-, or Zapier-level adoption, production history, or ecosystem scale without measured evidence.
